history.text: Hey, I'm Flow — we'll chat briefly, then you'll get two problems in the editor. Please start with a short introduction.
It's in your editor: Two Sum. Read it through, then tell me how you'd approach it before you write anything.

Um, okay, so for the Two Sum problem, I guess I would, like, first think about using a hash map to store the numbers and their indices. So, I'd iterate through the array, and, um, for each number, I'd check if the difference between the target and that number is already in the map. If it is, then I can return those indices. If not, I’d just add the number and its index to the map. Um, then I think that should work, right?
Got it. Go ahead and write that up in the editor when you're ready.
Your solution is efficient and correctly returns the indices for the two numbers that add up to the target.
Next one's in your editor: Valid Parentheses. Take a minute to read it, then talk me through your approach.

Um, okay, so for the Valid Parentheses problem, I think I would use a stack to keep track of the opening brackets. So, as I go through the string, um, whenever I see an opening bracket, I’d push it onto the stack. Then, for, like, closing brackets, I’d check if the stack is not empty and if the top of the stack matches the closing bracket. If it does, I’d pop the stack. If not, I’d return False. At the end, I'd check if the stack is empty, and if it is, then return True. Um, I guess that’s the general idea?

question_bank.title: Two Sum
question_bank.description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to `target`. Exactly one solution exists and you may not use the same element twice. Return the indices in increasing order.
hints: For each number, what complement would complete the pair?
A hash map of value->index gives O(n).

question_bank.title: Valid Parentheses
question_bank.description: Given a string `s` of just '()[]{}' characters, return True if every bracket is closed by the same type in the correct order, else False.
hints: A stack matches the most recent open bracket.
